I am Old Wang, 46, farming here in Quzhou for 26 years now. Five mu is not much, with four mouths at home and the wife and oldest sometimes working in town for cash. I went to primary school, so I can read the bag labels and count my money, but I learn most things from watching my neighbors and from what worked last year.

This year I plant kidney bean and spring maize, like last year. The maize takes most of the land because it feeds us and the price is steady — I give it about 3 mu. Kidney bean takes 2 mu because the trader in town pays good money for it and it does not eat much fertilizer.

For the maize seed, I buy Zhengdan or Xianyu hybrid seed from the dealer in the county town — one bag covers my 3 mu, costs me around 80 yuan. Hybrid gives much more than the old seed, everyone here uses it. For kidney bean I use improved seed I keep some from last year, plus buy a little fresh.

For the maize I put down compound fertilizer 15-15-15, two bags (100 jin) before planting with the rotary tiller — that is one bag per mu and a half, so about 50 jin per mu. Then when the maize is knee high I top-dress urea, about 30 jin per mu. That comes to roughly 18 kg nitrogen per mu, 7-8 kg phosphorus, 7-8 kg potassium. My neighbor Old Liu does similar and he gets good cobs. I would rather put a little extra urea than see yellow leaves — bad harvest is a real loss, a few extra yuan of fertilizer is nothing.

For kidney bean I use less, maybe one bag of compound 15-15-15 for the 2 mu, no top-dress urea — beans make their own nitrogen, my father taught me that. So about 7 kg N, 7 kg P, 7 kg K per mu.

I have well irrigation so I water the maize 3 times — after planting, at jointing, and when the cob is filling. Kidney bean I water 2 times if the rain is short. Pesticide I spray maize twice — once for armyworm and corn borer when I see them, once if aphids come. Kidney bean I spray 2-3 times because the pod borer is bad here, and bean flowers attract many insects.

Tillage I use rotary tiller, hire the machine from the village, 40 yuan per mu. Plough is too expensive and rotary is enough for our soil.

Expected yield: maize maybe 550 kg per mu if weather is normal — last year I got around there. Kidney bean about 180 kg per mu, sells for good price.
